title: Closeout summary: S02T08 - Compile handoff and workflow-next directives
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented S02T08 handoff and workflow-next directive compilation. Added compileHandoffAgentDirectiveBundle and handoffDirectiveDataByRegistryId, expanded handoff/workflow-next directive data to include summary IDs and URIs, branch/root, subject status, evidence and verification IDs, unresolved blockers, open descendants, gates, reservations, and next command/workflow inputs. Reused the richer workflow-next data from closeout/git/recovery paths. Updated golden fixtures and compiler tests for session handoff and workflow navigation. Scoped commit: e550efe3ac9606e66962b61be2d120447d6ecdab.

Close reason: Handoff and workflow-next directive compiler is implemented, tested, and committed.
